answers.label: 1 Do you or any of your branches/offices, subsidiaries or joint ventures have current or contemplated activity, directly or indirectly, in, with or involving any Sanctioned Jurisdiction?
answers.justification: The group has current activity in Belarus (Belorive Immobilier Belarus LLC, property leases) and Russia (Belorive Clôture Russia LLC, wind-down). Both are Sanctioned Jurisdictions.

answers.label: 2 Are you or any of your branches/offices, subsidiaries or joint ventures currently engaged or contemplate engaging in activities in any of the sectors in Russia that are subject to Sanctions, including without limitation: technology, defense and related materiel, electronics, marine, energy, accounting, trust and corporate formation, management consulting, quantum computing, trading/commodities brokering, financing and financial services, shipping, insurance, architecture, engineering, manufacturing, transportation, metals and mining, quarrying, fish/seafood (and preparations thereof), alcoholic beverages or non-industrial diamonds and diamond jewelry?
answers.source: sources/companies/sim-hackathon-b-client/activities.md#/activities/1/description; sources/companies/sim-hackathon-b-client/compliance.md#quote: There is no Russian-sector service business, Russian-origin oil trading or new Russia/Belarus investment.
answers.justification: The Russia activity is limited to wind-down (outstanding receivables and administrative closure expenses; no new sales or investment). Classification is 'ordinary non-controlled activity; no commodity code applicable.' No activity falls within the listed sanctioned sectors.

answers.label: 5 Do you intend to use or make available to your branches/offices, subsidiaries, joint ventures or any other third person, any La Banque des Entreprises accounts, products (including any partial usage of loans), services, systems, or platforms, directly or indirectly, to conduct any activity with or involving a (i) Sanctioned Party, (ii) Sanctioned Jurisdiction or (iii) Government of any of any country as listed in Question 4 (including any activities that are specifically authorized or not prohibited)?
answers.justification: Both subsidiary activities have bank_use=false. Compliance register confirms bank_use=false and describes isolation controls excluding issuer accounts from covered activities.

answers.label: 5 - details
answers.value: Controls ensuring La Banque des Entreprises is insulated: Issuer accounts, lending, guarantees, payment routes and platforms are excluded from covered activities; segregated ledgers and separate banking channels are used; treasury blocks covered payments and cash-pool transfers; compliance approves routing and reconciles monthly. No indirect issuer financing or settlement is permitted. No business with a Sanctioned Party or Sanctioned Government is identified (government flag is false for both activities). Sanctioned Jurisdiction details are provided in Part 2.
answers.justification: Isolation controls described in compliance register. No Sanctioned Party or Sanctioned Government involvement identified; jurisdiction details deferred to Part 2 per the question instructions.

answers.label: 7 Do you have a formal policy and/or program that ensures compliance with requirements of Sanctions?
answers.justification: A formal group sanctions compliance policy and program exists, applying to all controlled entities, branches and joint ventures, with screening, alert investigation, quarterly risk review, annual independent audit, and annual staff training.

answers.label: 7 - details
answers.value: Group policy applies to all controlled entities, branches and joint ventures. Screening of customers, beneficial owners, directors, employees, suppliers, end-users, intermediaries and transactions at onboarding, daily and before payment/shipment against scenario versions of Poland, EU, UN, UK and OFAC lists. Compliance investigates alerts; transactions held pending clearance. Periodic assessment: quarterly risk review, annual independent audit (last performed 2026-06-30), annual staff training, escalation and incident records maintained.
answers.justification: Full policy description from the compliance register, including the sanctions programs covered (Poland, EU, UN, UK, OFAC) and periodic assessment/audit schedule.
